# setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
setup_dir <- normalizePath("../setup", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(setup_dir, "setup.R"), local = TRUE)
plots_list <- list()
sample <- "vhio136"
int_dir <- file.path(datapath, sample, "integrated")
dir.create(file.path(int_dir, "seurat"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# merge

Samples already pre-processed with m01 and annotated as cd4 or cd8 based on pdfCluster and scGate consensus.

```{r}
object_RP <- readRDS(file.path(datapath, sample, "rootpath", "seurat", "SCT_rootpath.rds"))
object_VH <- readRDS(file.path(datapath, sample, "vhio", "seurat", "SCT_vhio.rds"))
obj <- list(object_RP, object_VH)
obj <- Reduce(merge, obj)
obj@meta.data$tag <- factor(obj@meta.data$tag, levels = c("pre_bulk1", "pre_bulk2", "pre_bulk3", "pre_pd1", "post1_bulk", "post1_pd1", "post2_bulk1", "post2_bulk2", "post2_bulk3", "post2_pd1", "post6_bulk", "post6_pd1"))
```

Manual curation of celltype to each ID.

```{r}
obj_cd8 <- obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(celltype == "cd8", !is.na(id)) %>%
  pull(id) %>% str_split(";") %>% unlist() %>% unique()
obj_cd4 <- obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(celltype == "cd4", !is.na(id)) %>%
  pull(id) %>% str_split(";") %>% unlist() %>% unique()
ids_overlap <- intersect(obj_cd8, obj_cd4)
tab_overlap <- obj@meta.data %>%
  filter(id %in% ids_overlap) %>%
  select(id, CD4_mag, CD8A_mag, CD8B_mag, celltype, scGate_multi)
tab_overlap$cell <- rownames(tab_overlap)
summary_id <- tab_overlap %>%
  dplyr::count(id, celltype) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = celltype,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )
id_map <- summary_id %>%
  left_join(
    tab_overlap %>%
      group_by(id) %>%
      summarise(
        CD4_med  = median(CD4_mag,  na.rm = TRUE),
        CD8A_med = median(CD8A_mag, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    assigned = case_when(
      cd8 > cd4 ~ "cd8",
      cd4 > cd8 ~ "cd4",
      TRUE ~ if_else(CD8A_med > CD4_med, "cd8", "cd4")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(id, assigned)
map_vec <- setNames(id_map$assigned, id_map$id)
idx <- which(obj@meta.data$id %in% names(map_vec))
new_label <- unname(map_vec[obj@meta.data$id[idx]])
obj@meta.data$celltype[idx] <- new_label
# --- Internal control ---
obj_cd8 <- obj@meta.data %>% filter(celltype == "cd8") %>% select(id) %>% filter(!is.na(id)) %>% unique()
obj_cd8 <- obj_cd8$id %>%
  str_split(";") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()
message("A total of ", length(obj_cd8), " unique TCRs have been annotated as CD8+ T cells")
obj_cd4 <- obj@meta.data %>% filter(celltype == "cd4") %>% select(id) %>% filter(!is.na(id)) %>% unique()
obj_cd4 <- obj_cd4$id %>%
  str_split(";") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()
message("A total of ", length(obj_cd4), " unique TCRs have been annotated as CD4+ T cells")
message("A total of ", length(union(obj_cd8, obj_cd4)), " unique library TCRs have been annotated")
```

# tcr annotation

```{r}
# --- Reconstructed reactive TCRs ---
reconstructed <- data.frame(
  id = c("#015", "#025", "#034", "#045"),
  cdr3 = c("CVAEDRVGQNFVF;CASSLIGASGNTEAFF", "CAVKQNNNARLMF;CASSLATGASTDTQYF", "CAAGPGGGADGLTF;CASTTGFGNTEAFF", "CVVNSISGGGADGLTF;CAISELGTGNNEQFF"),
  v_gene = c("TRAV12-1;TRBV5-1", "TRAV1-1*01;TRBV7-8*01", "TRAV29/DV5;TRBV28", "TRAV12-1;TRBV10-3"),
  j_gene = c("TRAJ26;TRBJ1-1", "TRAJ31*01;TRBJ2-3*01", "TRAJ45;TRBJ1-1", "TRAJ45;TRBJ2-1"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
make_tcr_key <- function(cdr3, v_gene, j_gene) {
  paste(trimws(as.character(cdr3)), trimws(as.character(v_gene)), trimws(as.character(j_gene)), sep = "||")
}
append_id <- function(old_id, new_id) {
  if (is.na(new_id) || !nzchar(new_id)) return(old_id)
  old_id <- as.character(old_id)
  if (is.na(old_id) || !nzchar(old_id) || old_id %in% c("NA", "NaN")) return(new_id)
  ids <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(old_id, ";", fixed = TRUE), use.names = FALSE))
  ids <- ids[nzchar(ids)]
  paste(unique(c(ids, new_id)), collapse = ";")
}
meta <- obj@meta.data
if (!"id" %in% colnames(meta)) {
  meta$id <- NA_character_
}
reconstructed$key <- make_tcr_key(reconstructed$cdr3, reconstructed$v_gene, reconstructed$j_gene)
meta$key <- make_tcr_key(meta$cdr3, meta$v_gene, meta$j_gene)
idx <- match(meta$key, reconstructed$key)
meta$id <- mapply(append_id, meta$id, reconstructed$id[idx], USE.NAMES = FALSE)
meta$key <- NULL
obj@meta.data <- as.data.frame(meta)
# --- Convert ChosenID.* to ID.* while preserving reconstructed #IDs ---
format_one_id <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(x)
  if (grepl("^#", x)) return(x)
  if (grepl("^ChosenID\\.[0-9]+$", x)) {
    num <- as.integer(sub("^ChosenID\\.", "", x))
    return(paste0("ID.", sprintf("%03d", num)))
  }
  x
}
format_chosen_ids <- function(x) {
  vapply(as.character(x), function(s) {
    if (is.na(s) || !nzchar(s)) return(NA_character_)
    ids <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(s, ";", fixed = TRUE), use.names = FALSE))
    ids <- ids[nzchar(ids)]
    ids <- vapply(ids, format_one_id, character(1))
    paste(unique(ids), collapse = ";")
  }, character(1))
}
obj@meta.data$id <- format_chosen_ids(obj@meta.data$id)
message("A total of ", length(unique(unlist(strsplit(na.omit(obj@meta.data$id), ";", fixed = TRUE)))), " unique tested TCRs have been annotated")
# --- Load TCR library metadata ---
tcr_lib <- fread(file.path(datapath_load, "outs/tcr_lib_annotated.txt"))
tcr_lib_dt <- as.data.table(copy(tcr_lib))
if (!"criteria_simplified" %in% colnames(tcr_lib_dt) && "tag_combination_controls" %in% colnames(tcr_lib_dt)) {
  tcr_lib_dt[, criteria_simplified := tag_combination_controls]
}
if (!"tag_combination_controls" %in% colnames(tcr_lib_dt) && "criteria_simplified" %in% colnames(tcr_lib_dt)) {
  tcr_lib_dt[, tag_combination_controls := criteria_simplified]
}
required_cols <- c("id", "criteria_simplified", "tag_combination_controls", "reactivity")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(tcr_lib_dt))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns in tcr_lib: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
tcr_lib_dt[, id := as.character(id)]
tcr_lib_dt[, criteria_simplified := as.character(criteria_simplified)]
tcr_lib_dt[, tag_combination_controls := as.character(tag_combination_controls)]
tcr_lib_dt[, reactivity := as.character(reactivity)]
simplify_criteria <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tokens <- unlist(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE), use.names = FALSE)
  tokens <- unlist(strsplit(tokens, "\\s*\\|\\s*"), use.names = FALSE)
  tokens <- trimws(tokens)
  tokens <- unique(tokens[nzchar(tokens)])
  priority <- c("PD1", "Tumor", "Expanding")
  tokens <- c(priority[priority %in% tokens], setdiff(tokens, priority))
  paste(tokens, collapse = " | ")
}
collapse_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)])
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(x, collapse = ";")
}
tcr_lib_dt <- tcr_lib_dt[
  ,
  .(
    criteria_simplified = simplify_criteria(criteria_simplified),
    tag_combination_controls = collapse_unique(tag_combination_controls),
    reactivity = collapse_unique(reactivity)
  ),
  by = id
]
criteria_map <- setNames(tcr_lib_dt$criteria_simplified, tcr_lib_dt$id)
tag_map <- setNames(tcr_lib_dt$tag_combination_controls, tcr_lib_dt$id)
reactivity_map <- setNames(tcr_lib_dt$reactivity, tcr_lib_dt$id)
get_valid_ids <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(character(0))
  ids <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE), use.names = FALSE))
  ids <- unique(ids[nzchar(ids)])
  ids[ids %in% tcr_lib_dt$id]
}
collapse_tcrlib_ids <- function(x) {
  ids <- get_valid_ids(x)
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(ids, collapse = ";")
}
collapse_tcrlib_criteria <- function(x) {
  ids <- get_valid_ids(x)
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  simplify_criteria(criteria_map[ids])
}
collapse_tcrlib_tags <- function(x) {
  ids <- get_valid_ids(x)
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  collapse_unique(tag_map[ids])
}
collapse_tcrlib_reactivity <- function(x) {
  ids <- get_valid_ids(x)
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  collapse_unique(reactivity_map[ids])
}
obj@meta.data$id <- as.character(obj@meta.data$id)
obj@meta.data$matched_ID <- vapply(obj@meta.data$id, collapse_tcrlib_ids, character(1))
obj@meta.data$criteria_simplified <- vapply(obj@meta.data$id, collapse_tcrlib_criteria, character(1))
obj@meta.data$tag_combination_controls <- vapply(obj@meta.data$id, collapse_tcrlib_tags, character(1))
obj@meta.data$reactivity <- vapply(obj@meta.data$id, collapse_tcrlib_reactivity, character(1))
# --- Check reconstructed IDs absent from tcr_lib ---
missing_reconstructed_ids <- setdiff(reconstructed$id, tcr_lib_dt$id)
if (length(missing_reconstructed_ids) > 0) {
  message("These reconstructed IDs are present in obj but absent from tcr_lib: ", paste(missing_reconstructed_ids, collapse = ", "))
}
# --- Internal controls ---
has_reactivity <- function(x, value) {
  vapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x), ";", fixed = TRUE), function(z) {
    value %in% trimws(z)
  }, logical(1))
}
control.reactive.id <- obj@meta.data %>%
  select(id, matched_ID, reactivity) %>%
  filter(has_reactivity(reactivity, "Yes")) %>%
  distinct()
control.autoreactive.id <- obj@meta.data %>%
  select(id, matched_ID, reactivity) %>%
  filter(has_reactivity(reactivity, "Auto-reactive")) %>%
  distinct()
control.non.reactive.id <- obj@meta.data %>%
  select(id, matched_ID, reactivity) %>%
  filter(has_reactivity(reactivity, "No")) %>%
  distinct()
# --- Quick summary ---
message("Matched reconstructed cells: ", sum(grepl("#15|#25|#34|#45", obj@meta.data$id)))
message("Reactive cells: ", nrow(obj@meta.data[has_reactivity(obj@meta.data$reactivity, "Yes"), ]))
message("Auto-reactive cells: ", nrow(obj@meta.data[has_reactivity(obj@meta.data$reactivity, "Auto-reactive"), ]))
message("Non-reactive cells: ", nrow(obj@meta.data[has_reactivity(obj@meta.data$reactivity, "No"), ]))
# --- Final metadata cleanup ---
obj@meta.data <- obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("id", "tag_combination_controls"))) %>%
  as.data.frame()
obj@meta.data <- obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -dplyr::any_of(c("id", "tag_combination_controls")),
    -dplyr::matches("^is\\.pure_")
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(obj@meta.data) <- Cells(obj)
```

# projecTILs

Annotate T-cell functional states by mapping cells to the ProjecTILs human reference atlas: <https://github.com/carmonalab/ProjecTILs>

```{r}
# --- Download ProjecTILs human reference maps (first run only) ---
ref_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "setup", "refs")
dir.create(ref_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ref_cd4 <- file.path(ref_dir, "CD4T_human_ref_v1.rds")
ref_cd8 <- file.path(ref_dir, "CD8T_human_ref_v1.rds")
options(timeout = 1800)
if (!file.exists(ref_cd4)) {
  download.file(
    "https://api.figshare.com/v2/file/download/39012395",
    destfile = ref_cd4,
    method = "libcurl",
    mode = "wb"
  )
}
if (!file.exists(ref_cd8)) {
  download.file(
    "https://api.figshare.com/v2/file/download/41414556",
    destfile = ref_cd8,
    method = "libcurl",
    mode = "wb"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# --- CD4+ T cells ---
ref.use <- load.reference.map(ref = file.path(project_dir, "setup", "refs", "CD4T_human_ref_v1.rds"))
levels(factor(ref.use$functional.cluster))
cd4_cells <- subset(obj, subset = celltype == "cd4")
set.seed(SEED)
cd4_cells <- make.projection(cd4_cells, ref = ref.use, filter.cells = FALSE, skip.normalize = TRUE, ncores = REPRO_NCORES)
cd4_cells <- cellstate.predict(ref = ref.use, query = cd4_cells)
cd4_cells <- cd4_cells@meta.data
cd4_cells <- subset(cd4_cells, select = c("functional.cluster", "functional.cluster.conf"))
# --- CD8+ T cells ---
ref.use <- load.reference.map(ref = file.path(project_dir, "setup", "refs", "CD8T_human_ref_v1.rds"))
levels(factor(ref.use$functional.cluster))
cd8_cells <- subset(obj, subset = celltype == "cd8")
set.seed(SEED)
cd8_cells <- make.projection(cd8_cells, ref = ref.use, filter.cells = FALSE, skip.normalize = TRUE, ncores = REPRO_NCORES)
cd8_cells <- cellstate.predict(ref = ref.use, query = cd8_cells)
cd8_cells <- cd8_cells@meta.data
cd8_cells <- subset(cd8_cells, select = c("functional.cluster", "functional.cluster.conf"))
cd4_cd8_cells <- rbind(cd4_cells, cd8_cells)
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, cd4_cd8_cells)
rm(ref.use, cd4_cells, cd8_cells, cd4_cd8_cells, Hs2Mm.convert.table)
```

TCRalpha/beta clonotype data.

```{r}
obj@meta.data$cell_id <- rownames(obj@meta.data)
clean_multi_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE)
  x <- lapply(x, function(y) {
    y <- gsub("\\*\\d+$", "", y)
    y <- gsub("-1$", "", y)
    paste(y, collapse = ";")
  })
  unlist(x)
}
obj@meta.data$v_gene <- clean_multi_gene(obj@meta.data$v_gene)
obj@meta.data$d_gene <- clean_multi_gene(obj@meta.data$d_gene)
obj@meta.data$j_gene <- clean_multi_gene(obj@meta.data$j_gene)
obj@meta.data$c_gene <- clean_multi_gene(obj@meta.data$c_gene)
chains_data <- obj@meta.data %>%
  select(cell_id, chains, cdr3, v_gene, j_gene) %>%
  mutate(
    chain_split = strsplit(as.character(chains), ";", fixed = TRUE),
    cdr3_split  = strsplit(as.character(cdr3),  ";", fixed = TRUE),
    v_split     = strsplit(as.character(v_gene), ";", fixed = TRUE),
    j_split     = strsplit(as.character(j_gene), ";", fixed = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    TCRa = {
      tra_idx <- which(chain_split == "TRA")
      if (length(tra_idx) > 0) {
        paste(
          mapply(
            function(c, v, j) paste0(c, "_", v, "_", j),
            cdr3_split[tra_idx],
            v_split[tra_idx],
            j_split[tra_idx]
          ),
          collapse = ";"
        )
      } else NA_character_
    },
    TCRb = {
      trb_idx <- which(chain_split == "TRB")
      if (length(trb_idx) > 0) {
        paste(
          mapply(
            function(c, v, j) paste0(c, "_", v, "_", j),
            cdr3_split[trb_idx],
            v_split[trb_idx],
            j_split[trb_idx]
          ),
          collapse = ";"
        )
      } else NA_character_
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cell_id, TCRa, TCRb)
chains_data$cell_id <- obj@meta.data$cell_id
chains_data <- chains_data %>% select(cell_id, TCRa, TCRb)
obj@meta.data <- obj@meta.data %>% left_join(chains_data, by = "cell_id") %>% column_to_rownames("cell_id")
rm(chains_data)
```

Fresh biopsy

```{r}
biopsy_trb <- fread(file.path(datapath_load, "outs/p136-Tfrozen_TCRB in frame.tsv")) %>%
  transmute(tcrb = str_c(aminoAcid, vMaxResolved, jMaxResolved, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(
    tcrb = str_replace_all(
      tcrb,
      c(
        "TCRBV" = "TRBV",
        "TCRBJ" = "TRBJ",
        "(?<!\\*)0+(\\d+)" = "\\1",
        "\\*\\d+" = "",
        "-1" = "",
        "_+" = "_",
        "_$" = ""
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(tcrb != "") %>%
  distinct(tcrb) %>%
  pull(tcrb)
obj@meta.data <- obj@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    tumor = ifelse(
      sapply(str_split(TCRb, ";"), function(x) any(trimws(x) %in% biopsy_trb)),
      "yes",
      "no"
    )
  )
```

# public

VDJdb
RIO-136 is HLA-A11:01, HLA-B35:01, HLA-B51:01, HLA-C04:01 and HLA-C15:02.
HLA-matched viral TRA, TCB or reconstructed TCR seqs https://vdjdb.cdr3.net/search
Epitope species: "CMV", "EBV", "HCV", "HIV-1", "HomoSapiens", "InfluenzaA", "SARS-CoV-2".

```{r}
obj@meta.data$cell_id <- rownames(obj@meta.data)
# TCRa
tra_vdjdb_orig <- fread(file.path(datapath_load, "outs/vdjdb/vdjdb_rio136_tra.tsv"), header = T)
tra_vdjdb <- tra_vdjdb_orig %>% select(CDR3, V, J, `Epitope gene`, `Epitope species`)
colnames(tra_vdjdb) <- c("tra", "v_gene", "j_gene", "epitope_gene", "epitope_species")
tra_vdjdb$v_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tra_vdjdb$v_gene)
tra_vdjdb$j_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tra_vdjdb$j_gene)
tra_vdjdb$TCRa <- paste0(tra_vdjdb$tra, "_", tra_vdjdb$v_gene, "_", tra_vdjdb$j_gene)
tra_vdjdb <- as.data.frame(tra_vdjdb) %>% distinct()
tra_vdjdb <- tra_vdjdb %>% 
  left_join(obj@meta.data %>% 
  select(cell_id, TCRa), by = "TCRa") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell_id)) %>%
  select(cell_id, epitope_species, epitope_gene) %>%
  mutate(match = "VDJdb_TRA")
# TCRb
trb_vdjdb_orig <- fread(file.path(datapath_load, "outs/vdjdb/vdjdb_rio136_trb.tsv"), header = T)
trb_vdjdb <- trb_vdjdb_orig %>% select(CDR3, V, J, `Epitope gene`, `Epitope species`)
colnames(trb_vdjdb) <- c("trb", "v_gene", "j_gene", "epitope_gene", "epitope_species")
trb_vdjdb$v_gene <- clean_multi_gene(trb_vdjdb$v_gene)
trb_vdjdb$j_gene <- clean_multi_gene(trb_vdjdb$j_gene)
trb_vdjdb$TCRb <- paste0(trb_vdjdb$trb, "_", trb_vdjdb$v_gene, "_", trb_vdjdb$j_gene)
trb_vdjdb <- as.data.frame(trb_vdjdb) %>% distinct()
trb_vdjdb <- trb_vdjdb %>% 
  left_join(obj@meta.data %>% 
  select(cell_id, TCRb), by = "TCRb") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell_id)) %>%
  select(cell_id, epitope_species, epitope_gene) %>%
  mutate(match = "VDJdb_TRB")
# TCR
# Verify that the TRB+TRA sequences described at https://vdjdb.cdr3.net/search matches the TRB+TRA of the single-cell data (reconstructed TCR). To do this, download the data set with the CDR3 paired only option, reconstruct the TCR, and check for a match.
vdjdb_paired <- fread(file.path(datapath_load, "outs/vdjdb/vdjdb_rio136_paired.tsv"), header = T)
complex.id <- unique(vdjdb_paired$complex.id)
vdjdb_paired_tcr <- list()
for (i in complex.id) {
  data_i <- subset(vdjdb_paired, subset = complex.id == i)
  tcr_i <- paste0(data_i[2, ]$CDR3, ";", data_i[1, ]$CDR3)
  v_gene <- paste0(data_i[2, ]$V, ";", data_i[1, ]$V)
  v_gene <- clean_multi_gene(v_gene)
  j_gene <- paste0(data_i[2, ]$J, ";", data_i[1, ]$J)
  j_gene <- clean_multi_gene(j_gene)
  specie_i <- unique(data_i$`Epitope species`)
  gene_i <- unique(data_i$`Epitope gene`)
  df_i <- data.frame(key = paste0(tcr_i, "|", v_gene, "|", j_gene),
                     epitope_species = specie_i,
                     epitope_gene = gene_i
                     )
  vdjdb_paired_tcr[[as.character(i)]] <- df_i
  rm(data_i, tcr_i, specie_i, gene_i, df_i, i)
}
tcr_vdjdb <- bind_rows(vdjdb_paired_tcr) %>% distinct()
tcr_vdjdb <- tcr_vdjdb %>%
  mutate(key = sapply(key, function(x) {
    bloques <- strsplit(x, "\\|")[[1]]
    bloques <- gsub("^;", "", bloques)
    bloques <- gsub(";$", "", bloques)
    paste(bloques, collapse = "|")
  }))
obj@meta.data$key <- paste0(obj$cdr3, "|", obj$v_gene, "|", obj$j_gene)
tcr_vdjdb <- tcr_vdjdb %>% 
  left_join(obj@meta.data %>% 
  select(cell_id, key), by = "key") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell_id)) %>%
  select(cell_id, epitope_species, epitope_gene) %>%
  mutate(match = "VDJdb_TCR")
rm(trb_vdjdb_orig, tra_vdjdb_orig, vdjdb_paired, complex.id, vdjdb_paired_tcr)
```

iedb
HLA-matched viral TCR https://iedb.org/

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Download the whole database and filtered for HLA-compatible entries for both tcrb or tcra+tcrb.
tcr_iedb_data <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(datapath_load, "outs/iedb/receptor_table_export_1713292478.xlsx"))
tcr_iedb_data <- as.data.frame(tcr_iedb_data)
tcr_iedb_data <- tcr_iedb_data %>% select(c("MHC Allele Names", "Type...13", "CDR3 Curated...24", "Type...42", "CDR3 Curated...53", "Source Organism", "Source Molecule"))
tcr_iedb_data <- subset(tcr_iedb_data, tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism` %in% c("Human herpesvirus 5 (Human cytomegalovirus)",
                                                                              "Human herpesvirus 4 (Epstein Barr virus)",
                                                                              "Hepatitis C virus",
                                                                              "Human immunodeficiency virus 1 (human immunodeficiency virus 1 HIV-1)",
                                                                              "Homo sapiens (human)",
                                                                              "Influenza A virus",
                                                                              "H1N1 subtype (H1N1)",
                                                                              "SARS-CoV2"))
tcr_iedb_data <- subset(tcr_iedb_data, tcr_iedb_data$`MHC Allele Names` %in% c("HLA-A*11:01", "HLA-B*35:01", "HLA-B*51:01", "HLA-C*04:01", "HLA-C*15:02"))
tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism` <- gsub("Homo sapiens \\(human\\)", "HomoSapiens", tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism`)
tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism` <- gsub("Human herpesvirus 4 \\(Epstein Barr virus\\)", "EBV", tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism`)
tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism` <- gsub("Human herpesvirus 5 \\(Human cytomegalovirus\\)", "CMV", tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism`)
tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism` <- gsub("Human immunodeficiency virus 1 \\(human immunodeficiency virus 1 HIV-1\\)", "HIV-1", tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism`)
tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism` <- gsub("SARS-CoV2", "SARS-CoV-2", tcr_iedb_data$`Source Organism`)
#TCRa
tra_iedb <- tcr_iedb_data[complete.cases(tcr_iedb_data$`CDR3 Curated...24`), ]
tra_iedb <- tra_iedb %>% select(`CDR3 Curated...24`, `Source Organism`, `Source Molecule`) %>% distinct()
colnames(tra_iedb) <- c("TRA", "epitope_species", "epitope_gene")
meta_data_with_tra <- obj@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    TRA = case_when(
      chains == "TRA;TRB" ~ str_split(cdr3, ";", simplify = TRUE)[, 1],
      chains == "TRA" ~ cdr3,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    cell_id = rownames(.)
  ) %>% select(cell_id, TRA)
tra_iedb <- tra_iedb %>% 
  left_join(meta_data_with_tra %>% select(cell_id, TRA), by = "TRA") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell_id)) %>%
  select(cell_id, epitope_species, epitope_gene) %>%
  mutate(match = "IEDB_TRA")
#TCRb
trb_iedb <- tcr_iedb_data[complete.cases(tcr_iedb_data$`CDR3 Curated...53`), ]
trb_iedb <- trb_iedb %>% select(`CDR3 Curated...53`, `Source Organism`, `Source Molecule`) %>% distinct()
colnames(trb_iedb) <- c("TRB", "epitope_species", "epitope_gene")
meta_data_with_trb <- obj@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    TRB = case_when(
      chains == "TRA;TRB" ~ str_split(cdr3, ";", simplify = TRUE)[, 2],
      chains == "TRB" ~ cdr3,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    cell_id = rownames(.)
  ) %>% select(cell_id, TRB)
trb_iedb <- trb_iedb %>% 
  left_join(meta_data_with_trb %>% select(cell_id, TRB), by = "TRB") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell_id)) %>%
  select(cell_id, epitope_species, epitope_gene) %>%
  mutate(match = "IEDB_TRB")
rm(tcr_iedb_data, tcr_iedb_data_complete, trb_iedb_clon, trb_iedb_paired_tcr_clon, trb_vdjdb_clon, trb_vdjdb_paired_tcr_clon, meta_data_with_tra, meta_data_with_trb)
```

Combine all viral TRB and TRB+TRA from different databases and annotate epitope specie and gene for matching cells.

```{r}
viral_info <- bind_rows(tra_vdjdb, trb_vdjdb, tcr_vdjdb, tra_iedb, trb_iedb) %>%
  group_by(cell_id) %>%
  summarise(across(c(epitope_species, epitope_gene, match),
                   ~ paste(unique(.), collapse = ";")),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(database = match)
obj@meta.data <- obj@meta.data %>%
  left_join(viral_info, by = "cell_id") %>%
  mutate(across(c(epitope_species, epitope_gene, database),
                ~ if_else(epitope_species %in% c("EBV","CMV"), ., NA_character_))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cell_id")
rm(tcr_vdjdb, tra_iedb, tra_vdjdb, trb_iedb, trb_vdjdb, viral_info)
```

# signatures

Cell-cycle score + Yossef's gene-signature scores for tumor-reactive PBLs @ Cancer Cell Table S5

```{r}
signatures <- fread(file.path(datapath_load, "outs/signatures.tsv"), header = TRUE)
sigs <- lapply(signatures, function(x) unique(na.omit(x)))
sigs <- c(
  sigs,
  list(
    cycling.g1 = as.vector(scGate::genes.blacklist.default$Hs$cellCycle.G1S),
    cycling.g2 = as.vector(scGate::genes.blacklist.default$Hs$cellCycle.G2M)
  )
)

rm(sigs, signature.names)
```

# scRepertoire

<https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/scRepertoire/inst/doc/vignette.html#8_Combining_Clones_and_Single-Cell_Objects>

```{r}
folder_data <- "rootpath"
object_files_rp <- list.files(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data))
object_tags_rp <- c("post2_bulk1", "post2_bulk2", "post2_bulk3", "post2_pd1", "pre_bulk1", "pre_bulk2", "pre_bulk3", "pre_pd1")
data_repertoire_rp <- list()
for (i in seq_along(object_files_rp)) {
  tcr <- read.csv(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data, object_files_rp[[i]], "filtered_contig_annotations.csv"))
  tcr$v_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tcr$v_gene)
  tcr$d_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tcr$d_gene)
  tcr$j_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tcr$j_gene)
  tcr$c_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tcr$c_gene)
  data_repertoire_rp[[as.character(object_tags_rp[[i]])]] <- tcr
}
folder_data <- "vhio"
object_files_vh <- list.files(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data))
object_tags_vhio <- c("post1_bulk", "post1_pd1", "post6_bulk", "post6_pd1")
data_repertoire_vhio <- list()
for (i in seq_along(object_files_vh)) {
  tcr <- read.csv(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data, object_files_vh[[i]], "filtered_contig_annotations.csv"))
  tcr$v_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tcr$v_gene)
  tcr$d_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tcr$d_gene)
  tcr$j_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tcr$j_gene)
  tcr$c_gene <- clean_multi_gene(tcr$c_gene)
  data_repertoire_vhio[[as.character(object_tags_rp[[i]])]] <- tcr
}
data_repertoire <- c(data_repertoire_rp, data_repertoire_vhio)
samples <- c(object_files_rp, object_files_vh)
combined.TCR <- combineTCR(data_repertoire, 
                           samples = c(object_tags_rp, object_tags_vhio),
                           removeNA = FALSE,
                           removeMulti = FALSE, 
                           filterMulti = FALSE)
sce_count_data <- combineExpression(combined.TCR,
                                    obj,
                                    cloneCall="gene",
                                    group.by = "sample",
                                    proportion = FALSE,
                                    cloneSize=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500)
                                    )
obj@meta.data <- sce_count_data@meta.data
```

# subset

## CD8+

```{r}
obj.cd8 <- subset(obj, subset = celltype == "cd8")
```

Bulk + PD^1

Step 1. Distribution of the annotation scores and identification of the cut-offs that allow the annotation of e.g. 50% of the cell (recommended by Massimo Andreatta).

```{r}
med_dist <- list()
med_plots <- list()
phenotype <- names(table(obj.cd8$functional.cluster))
for (i in phenotype) {
    obj_i <- subset(obj.cd8, subset = functional.cluster == i)
    median_i <- median(obj_i@meta.data$functional.cluster.conf, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_dist[[i]] <- median_i
    plot_i <- ggplot(obj_i@meta.data, aes_string(x = "functional.cluster.conf")) + 
              geom_density() + 
              geom_vline(xintercept = median_i, linetype = "dashed", color = "red3") + 
              labs(title = paste(i, "\nmedian =", round(median_i, 2))) +
      theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
    med_plots[[i]] <- plot_i
}
wrap_plots(med_plots, ncol = 4)
```

Step 2. Reassign annotations based on their confidence score. All cells below the median were marked as 'unknown' for STACAS integration.

```{r}
obj.cd8$functional.cluster_stacas <- "unknown"
for (i in phenotype){
  threshold <- med_dist[[i]]
  obj.cd8$functional.cluster_stacas <- ifelse(obj.cd8$functional.cluster == i & obj.cd8$functional.cluster.conf >= threshold, obj.cd8$functional.cluster, obj.cd8$functional.cluster_stacas)
}
rm(phenotype, threshold, i, med_dist)
DefaultAssay(obj.cd8) <- "SCT"
```

Step 3. Identify variable features across all datasets. Also add variable features from projecTILs that fall into the top-1500 variable genes. Guided by the authors.

```{r}
obj.cd8.list <- SplitObject(obj.cd8, split.by = "sample")
obj.cd8.list <- lapply(obj.cd8.list, function(x) {FindVariableFeatures.STACAS(x, nfeat = 1500, genesBlockList = genes.blacklist.default$Hs)})
varfeat <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = obj.cd8.list, nfeatures = 1500)
var_projecTILs <- list()
for (i in c('CD4T', 'CD8T')) {
  ref.use <- load.reference.map(ref = paste0(project_dir, "/setup/refs/", paste0(i, "_human_ref_v1.rds")))
  file.path(project_dir, "setup", "refs", "CD8T_human_ref_v1.rds")
  var_projecTILs[[i]] <- row.names(ref.use@assays$integrated)
}
varfeat <- unique(c(varfeat, var_projecTILs$CD8T))
```

Step 4. Loop STACAS pipeline for different annotations:
<https://carmonalab.github.io/STACAS.demo/STACAS.demo.html#one-liner-stacas>
<https://github.com/carmonalab/STACAS/blob/master/R/main.R>

```{r}
obj.cd8.list <- lapply(obj.cd8.list, function(x) {
  x <- x[rownames(obj.cd8.list[[1]]), ]
  return(x)
})
ndim <- 8
res <- 0.75
set.seed(SEED)
obj.cd8.int <- Run.STACAS(obj.cd8.list,
                      assay = rep("SCT", 12),
                      new.assay.name = "STACAS",
                      reference = NULL,
                      max.seed.objects = ndim,
                      min.sample.size = 100,
                      anchor.features = varfeat,
                      genesBlockList = genes.blacklist.default$Hs,
                      dims = ndim,
                      k.anchor = 5,
                      k.score = 30,
                      k.weight = 75,
                      alpha = 0.7,
                      anchor.coverage = 0.5,
                      correction.scale = 1.5,
                      cell.labels = "functional.cluster.conf",
                      label.confidence = 0.95,
                      scale.data = FALSE,
                      hclust.method = "complete",
                      seed = SEED,
                      verbose = FALSE
)
```

#### Manual annotations

First, identify markers in each cluster

```{r}
# --- Join layers ---
cluster_col <- paste0("STACAS_snn_res.", res)
DefaultAssay(obj.cd8.nn) <- "RNA"
obj.cd8.nn <- JoinLayers(
  obj.cd8.nn,
  assay = "RNA"
)
obj.cd8.nn <- NormalizeData(
  obj.cd8.nn,
  assay = "RNA",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000,
  verbose = FALSE
)
Layers(obj.cd8.nn[["RNA"]])

# --- Identify markers ---
Idents(obj.cd8.nn) <- obj.cd8.nn[[cluster_col, drop = TRUE]]
markers.cd8.nn <- FindAllMarkers(
  obj.cd8.nn,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  return.thresh = 0.05
)
top.markers.cd8.nn <- markers.cd8.nn %>%
  filter(
    p_val_adj < 0.05,
    avg_log2FC > 0.25,
    pct.1 > 0.25,
    pct.1 > pct.2,
    pct.1 - pct.2 > 0.10
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 50, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, pct.1, pct.2, p_val_adj)

# --- Generate a list for annotation ---
n_top <- 50
fc_col <- if ("avg_log2FC" %in% colnames(markers.cd8.nn)) "avg_log2FC" else "avg_logFC"
marker_list.cd8.nn <- markers.cd8.nn %>%
  filter(
    p_val_adj < 0.05,
    .data[[fc_col]] > 0.25,
    pct.1 > 0.25,
    pct.1 > pct.2,
    pct.1 - pct.2 > 0.10
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = .data[[fc_col]], n = n_top, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(
    markers = paste(gene, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(as.character(cluster))) %>%
  mutate(line = paste0(cluster, ": ", markers))
cat(paste(marker_list.cd8.nn$line, collapse = "\n"))

```

Manually annotation

CD8 TCM = basal/quiescent central memory; low cytotoxicity; TCF7/CD28/IL7R/SELL-like.
CD8 activated TCM-like = recently activated central-memory-like cells; still low-to-intermediate cytotoxicity; EGR1/AREG/SOCS3/CD83/NFKBIA-like activation.
CD8 activated TEM = activated effector-memory cells; intermediate cytotoxicity; GZMK/GZMA with HLA-II activation signature.
CD8 TEMRA FGFBP2+ = highly cytotoxic terminal effector/TEMRA cells; strong FGFBP2/GZMB/GZMH/GNLY/PRF1/KLRD1/TBX21 program.
CD8 TEMRA LILRB1+ = terminal cytotoxic TEMRA-like cells with inhibitory/NK-like features; LILRB1/FCGR3A/ADGRG1/ZEB2 with GNLY/GZMB.
Proliferating CD8 T cells = cycling activated CD8 cells; proliferation-dominant rather than purely cytotoxic; MKI67/PCLAF/STMN1/MCM/NUSAP1-high.

```{r}
obj.cd8.nn$manual.annotation <- dplyr::recode(
  as.character(obj.cd8.nn$STACAS_snn_res.0.5),
  "0" = "CD8 TEMRA FGFBP2+",
  "1" = "CD8 activated TEM",
  "2" = "CD8 TCM",
  "3" = "CD8 activated TCM-like",
  "4" = "CD8 proliferating",
  "5" = "CD8 TEMRA KLRG1+",
  "6" = "CD8 TEMRA LILRB1+",
  .default = NA_character_
)
obj.cd8.nn$manual.annotation <- factor(
  obj.cd8.nn$manual.annotation,
  levels = c(
    "CD8 TCM",
    "CD8 activated TCM-like",
    "CD8 activated TEM",
    "CD8 TEMRA KLRG1+",
    "CD8 TEMRA FGFBP2+",
    "CD8 TEMRA LILRB1+",
    "CD8 proliferating"
  )
)
manual_colors <- c(
  "CD8 TCM"                = "#0B6F61",
  "CD8 activated TCM-like" = "#84D8C5",
  "CD8 activated TEM"      = "#E45C95",
  "CD8 TEMRA KLRG1+"       = "#00A6D6",
  "CD8 TEMRA FGFBP2+"      = "#123FD1",
  "CD8 TEMRA LILRB1+"      = "#78B7F9",
  "CD8 proliferating"      = "#4B1D73"
)
DimPlot(
  obj.cd8.nn,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "manual.annotation",
  label = F,
  repel = F,
  label.size = 5,
  pt.size = 0.1,
  cols = manual_colors
) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

# --- Save with the manual annotations ---
saveRDS(obj.cd8.nn, file.path(int_dir, "seurat/cd8_int_nn.rds"))
```

Internal control

```{r}
criteria_patterns <- c(
  "Expanding" = "Expanding",
  "PD1"       = "PD[-_ ]?1|PD1",
  "Tumor"     = "Tumor",
  "Frequent"  = "Frequent"
)
criteria_colors <- c(
  "Expanding" = "red3",
  "PD1"       = "#5B2A86",
  "Tumor"     = "#E76F51",
  "Frequent"  = "#4C78A8"
)
make_criteria_plot_by_time <- function(obj, pattern, label, color, reduction = "umap") {
  emb <- Embeddings(obj, reduction = reduction)[, 1:2]
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    UMAP_1 = emb[, 1],
    UMAP_2 = emb[, 2],
    criteria_simplified = as.character(obj$criteria_simplified),
    time = as.character(obj$time)
  )
  plot_df$time <- factor(
    plot_df$time,
    levels = c("pre", "post1", "post2", "post6")
  )
  plot_df$highlight <- !is.na(plot_df$criteria_simplified) &
    grepl(pattern, plot_df$criteria_simplified, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df[!plot_df$highlight, ],
      color = "grey85",
      size = 0.1,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df[plot_df$highlight, ],
      color = color,
      size = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~time, nrow = 1, drop = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(label) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank()
    )
}
p_expanding <- make_criteria_plot_by_time(
  obj.cd8.nn,
  pattern = criteria_patterns["Expanding"],
  label = "Expanding",
  color = criteria_colors["Expanding"]
)
p_pd1 <- make_criteria_plot_by_time(
  obj.cd8.nn,
  pattern = criteria_patterns["PD1"],
  label = "PD1",
  color = criteria_colors["PD1"]
)
p_tumor <- make_criteria_plot_by_time(
  obj.cd8.nn,
  pattern = criteria_patterns["Tumor"],
  label = "Tumor",
  color = criteria_colors["Tumor"]
)
p_frequent <- make_criteria_plot_by_time(
  obj.cd8.nn,
  pattern = criteria_patterns["Frequent"],
  label = "Frequent",
  color = criteria_colors["Frequent"]
)
p_expanding / p_pd1 / p_tumor / p_frequent
```

```{r}
for (i in phenotype){
  threshold <- med_dist[[i]]
  obj.cd4$functional.cluster_stacas <- ifelse(obj.cd4$functional.cluster == i & obj.cd4$functional.cluster.conf >= threshold, obj.cd4$functional.cluster, obj.cd4$functional.cluster_stacas)
}
rm(phenotype, threshold, i, med_dist)
DefaultAssay(obj.cd4) <- "SCT"
```

Step 3. Identify variable features across all datasets. Also add variable features from projecTILs that fall into the top-1500 variable genes. Guided by the authors.

```{r}
obj.cd4.list <- SplitObject(obj.cd4, split.by = "sample")
obj.cd4.list <- lapply(obj.cd4.list, function(x) {FindVariableFeatures.STACAS(x, nfeat = 1500, genesBlockList = genes.blacklist.default$Hs)})
varfeat <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = obj.cd4.list, nfeatures = 1500)
var_projecTILs <- list()
for (i in c('CD4T', 'CD8T')) {
  ref.use <- load.reference.map(ref = file.path(project_dir, "setup", "refs", paste0(i, "_human_ref_v1.rds")))
  var_projecTILs[[i]] <- row.names(ref.use@assays$integrated)
}
varfeat <- unique(c(varfeat, var_projecTILs$CD4T))
```

Step 4. Loop STACAS pipeline for different annotations:
<https://carmonalab.github.io/STACAS.demo/STACAS.demo.html#one-liner-stacas>
<https://github.com/carmonalab/STACAS/blob/master/R/main.R>

```{r}
obj.cd4.list <- lapply(obj.cd4.list, function(x) {
  x <- x[rownames(obj.cd4.list[[1]]), ]
  return(x)
})
ndim <- 8
res <- 0.75
set.seed(SEED)
obj.cd4.int <- Run.STACAS(obj.cd4.list,
                      assay = rep("SCT", 12),
                      new.assay.name = "STACAS",
                      reference = NULL,
                      max.seed.objects = ndim,
                      min.sample.size = 100,
                      anchor.features = varfeat,
                      genesBlockList = genes.blacklist.default$Hs,
                      dims = ndim,
                      k.anchor = 5,
                      k.score = 30,
                      k.weight = 75,
                      alpha = 0.7,
                      anchor.coverage = 0.5,
                      correction.scale = 1.5,
                      cell.labels = "functional.cluster.conf",
                      label.confidence = 0.95,
                      scale.data = FALSE,
                      hclust.method = "complete",
                      seed = SEED,
                      verbose = FALSE
)
```

### Bulk + PD-1^hi

```{r}
DefaultAssay(obj.cd4.int) <- "STACAS"
ndim <- 30
res <- 0.5
obj.cd4.int <- run_dimred_cluster(
  obj.cd4.int,
  ndim = ndim,
  res = res,
  n_neighbors = 80,
  min_dist = 0.6,
  k_param = 30,
  reduction_name = "umap"
)
DimPlot(obj.cd4.int, reduction = "umap", group.by = "functional.cluster", label = F, label.size = 5, cols = phenotype_colors) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
DimPlot(obj.cd4.int, reduction = "umap", group.by = paste0("STACAS_snn_res.", res), label = F, label.size = 5) + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
saveRDS(obj.cd4.int, file.path(int_dir, "seurat/cd4_int.rds"))
```
